FOrcaSlicer 2.3.2-fos.8.6.7

Fixed: when a plate's second filament was used only for the inner wall, the prime tower was not shown in Prepare, so it could not be moved, and it could be sliced partly off the plate.

New: a Hide online models checkbox next to the refresh button under Recommended for You on the Home page. While it is ticked, the recommended models and their thumbnails are not downloaded. My Devices, Recent Files and sign-in are not affected.

Faster first launch: on some computers the first launch after the machine had been idle took 11 to 18 seconds before the window appeared. The printer profiles are now read in parallel, so a first launch is as fast as a repeat launch.
